prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop SaaS UI mockup screenshot for "新商机 OPC社区", an AI tools and learning community platform. Use the attached reference screenshot as the dominant visual style reference.

Global visual style:
- 16:9 desktop app screenshot, exactly like a browser-based platform page at 1200x720 class proportions.
- Use a light blue-gray page background #f4f7fb, white content cards, and a very thin dark window top edge.
- Keep the same shell as the reference: browser tab bar with two "首页" tabs, plus icon, gift icon, green "立即登录" pill, hamburger/menu icon, and Windows-style controls.
- Brand: large handwritten/italic "新商机" in vivid red and "OPC社区" in warm gold, positioned at the upper left.
- Top search bar: long rounded white input with purple border and a purple circular search button at the right.
- VIP strip: dark navy rounded pill with gold VIP badge, text "开通会员，享100+办公权益", and gold button "立即开通".
- Top channel navigation uses large bold black Chinese labels with the active item in purple blue and a short underline. It should feel like the screenshot: "常用", "AI 助理", "AI 营销", "AI 视频", "AI 音频", "AI 编程", "AI 写作", "AI 电商", "AI 法务", "AI 客服", "AI 办公", "AI 教育", "AI 科研".
- Left sidebar is pale gray, 150px wide, with compact icon+text rows. Active row has light purple background. Include small red "新" badges where useful.
- Main content starts near x=180, uses compact section headings with a trailing ">", and rounded tool cards.
- Right promo card should echo the reference style when relevant: red-orange gradient panel, white/yellow text, small document thumbnail stack, and a clear button.
- Primary color: purple blue #6657f5. Secondary accents: red #ff5a4f, gold #ffd486, teal #24c5a4, muted slate text.
- Use 8px to 10px card radius, 1px light borders, restrained shadows, compact spacing, and Lucide-style line icons.
- No landing page hero, no decorative orbs, no bokeh, no giant gradients, no nested cards, no stock photo hero, no cartoon mascot.
- UI must look like a real product workbench with clear modules, data tables, task queues, filters, buttons, progress bars, and side panels.
- All visible text should be simplified Chinese. Prioritize readable titles, section headings, table headers, buttons, labels, and status chips.
- Avoid tiny unreadable paragraphs. Use concise Chinese copy and stable UI text.

Shared chrome:
- Top window/browser bar: active tab label "首页", a second tab "首页", gift icon, "立即登录", hamburger/menu icon.
- Brand row: "新商机 OPC社区", search placeholder "搜索你需要的 AI 助理、工具或模板", VIP strip "VIP 开通会员，享100+办公权益", button "立即开通".
- Top tabs: "常用", "AI 助理", "AI 营销", "AI 视频", "AI 音频", "AI 编程", "AI 写作", "AI 电商", "AI 法务", "AI 客服", "AI 办公", "AI 教育", "AI 科研".
- Use an active tab underline in #6657f5.
